name: Triton batch-execution counter
notes: Triton main, docs/user_guide/metrics.md, read 2026-10-04. On by default: 'By default, these metrics are available at http://localhost:8002/metrics', and the endpoint is pure pull - 'not pushed or published to any remote server'. tritonserver --allow-metrics=false turns the whole thing off. Labels are model and version, and crucially the LATENCY families are per MODEL, per request-update - not per-request observations as in vLLM/SGLang/TGI. Counts batch executions. The docs walk through batch-1+batch-1 giving Request 2 / Inference 2 / Execution 1, which is the whole reason all three counters exist.
